remaining_limitations.description: Enterprise multi-user RBAC and token-based cryptographic session validation deferred; local single-user mode operates with caller-declared reviewer identity explicitly disclosed in UI.

Original E01 raw image (7.55 GB) historical pre-test SHA-256 hash was unrecorded in git repository benchmarks; integrity enforced by OS read-only mount, byte size verification, and strict zero-write policy.
Track C (Live Model Browser E2E) remains explicitly unauthorized and unexercised to prevent unauthorized external LLM data egress; offline deterministic qualification applies.
